answer_1.quote: We evaluate the proposed model on three tasks: (i) language modeling, (ii) unaligned style transfer, and (iii) dialog-response generation...
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences for language modeling, stylized sentences for style transfer, and dialogue responses for dialog-response generation.

answer_2.quote: To benchmark language modeling performance, we report the ELBO and Perplexity (PPL)... we also report the KL divergence D_KL and mutual information (MI)... For unaligned style transfer, we consider the transfer accuracy, BLEU scores, reconstruction perplexity, and reverse perplexity (RPPL)... For dialogue-response generation, we adopt the evaluation metrics including BLEU, BOW, and intra/inter-dist values.

answer_4.quote: We further perform human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk. We asked the turkers to compare generated responses from two models, and assess each model's informativeness, relevance to the dialog context (coherence), and diversity.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers compare pairs of model outputs and rate them on informativeness, relevance (coherence) to the dialog context, and diversity.
